verdict.rationale: Salesmate's own marketing pages describe workflow automations ('smart flow credits' to 'automate your end-to-end sales and marketing playbooks'), automated nurture journeys, and AI agents that update CRM records 'autonomously without manual intervention'. That establishes a first-party background-automation capability, but only as high-level claims with no detail on how automations are configured or run. Missing for 10: documentation of how automations are set up (triggers, conditions, schedules), explicit evidence of recurring or background execution and monitoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: With extra smart flow credits, scale your workflow automations and automate your end-to-end sales and marketing playbooks.
Update CRM records, fields, and activities autonomously without manual intervention
automate nurture journeys, and run campaigns using the same customer data your teams already rely on
